parameters.name: AFCAvailableSpectrumInquiryResponse

object.description: This object contains the Available Spectrum Inquiry request and response message defined by {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 8.2.5}}. This provides information of 6 GHz spectrum availability as determined by an Automated Frequency Coordination (AFC) system {{bibref|AFCSDI}}.
